items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: I met another guy that I'd heard about, but I didn't know him, and he was from Miami -- that was Cedric Wallace... Now her uncle, Cedric Wallace, was a bass player with Fats Waller for years.

ctx.x: So I only lived at 131st Street at Lenox Avenue at the time, with my father. So I went by the Rhythm Club the next day, and the next guy I saw, he was in Miami with his band then at one time, and I saw him, and I introduced myself to him -- this was Kaiser Marshall. He was sharp, boy; you know, he was a sharp dresser, anyway, you know. And I met Kaiser Marshall, and I reminded him of who I was, because you know, I saw him down in Miami when he came to play at the Delorobia.
